source_authority: original Dovlin collection approved story and uploaded image-source map
visual_fidelity_rule: Only owner-approved colour changes may be made to the canonical Dovlin character lines. Wings, tail, horns, eyes, silhouette and gold dove emblem must not change. Do not automatically approve apparent matches.
publication_rule: Concept art, fabric colours, digital mockups or source image availability do not establish a manufactured unit, safety approval, verified materials, purchasable SKU or inventory.
